# Shrub

> Shrub - Making Lending Accessible. Shrub Lend: borrow USDC against ETH at a rate that locks the moment you borrow. Built on Aave V3, on Base. By Shrub Finance, Inc.

This file is the text of https://shrub.finance/ for language models. The page is the source of truth.

## There is a fundamental that runs the world.

**Borrow against what you own without selling it.** Every economy on earth runs on this.

It barely exists on-chain. Not because it can't. Because someone has to absorb the rate complexity so the borrower never sees it.

That is WHAT Shrub does.
That is ALL Shrub does.

You have ETH. You need USDC.
The rate locks the moment you borrow.

- from 0% at 20% LTV
- from 1% at 25% LTV
- from 5% at 33.3% LTV
- from 8% at 50% LTV

1% origination fee. No early repayment penalty.

It unlocks liquidity from your asset without a floating rate to lose sleep over. **The way loans are supposed to work.**

We serve the individual, not institutions. No custom deals. No preferred terms. This is what the Last Builders are doing.

## Simple and easy are not the same thing.

Easy is surface. Simple is structure.

You do not arrive at simple by adding features. You arrive at it by refusing to stop until the thing you built needs nothing explained.

We had a working protocol. Won pitches. Had funding on the table. Then someone we respected told us the deposit side was unnecessary weight.

So we walked away from the funding and went back to the beginning.

Not because it was broken. **Because it could be better.**

That is the discipline to begin again. Twice. Three times. However many it takes until the person using it has nothing to figure out.

## We are here because we want to be.

Not because we could not be somewhere else. Most projects arrive to capture a wave and leave when it passes. We self-fund now. The product is built to sustain itself by serving borrowers. The builders carry the rest.

No outside money deciding what this becomes.

Built by people who believe money should stay free. Used by people who feel the same.

Nothing to inflate. It is exactly what it is meant to be.

It serves a small set of people who opted in. Quiet builders setting the template for how money should work in DeFi. The right way. The slow way.

Real ETH. Real USDC. Every locked rate honored.

Every person who battle tested it and shaped it from the beginning is still here.

The thing working is the proof we have.

## For those invited

This is for long-term holders who never entered crypto to make fast money. Who can tell the difference between something built to be talked about and something built to be used.

When you need your asset to work without selling it, this is here, for those invited.

Connect with us.

If you want to be a part of building something where you belong, where you are a part, not a participant, email connect@shrub.finance and we will put you on the Last Builders waitlist.
